_comment: How many summons a monster controls at once (Managers.MonsterSummonCaps). A monster has no summon
capacity in the client's data, so without a row here it summons as often as its spells let it.
Each row is a guide's word, quoted in its why.
cap       the summon capacity it has, counted as a player's: each summon takes its summonCost

caps.why: Master Cuerbok's Invocación de Cuerbok (629, once a turn): «Invoque un Corbac. Il ne peut y avoir qu'un seul Corbac invoqué sur le terrain [...] Si ce Corbac est éliminé, il peut en réinvoquer un directement au tour suivant» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Bibliothèque du Maître Corbac»). The crow (281) costs 1.
